title: The Stuff of Thought | Steven Pinker | Talks at Google
summary: Steven Pinker presents his book The Stuff of Thought at Google in 2007. He covers language as a window into human nature, including taboo words, swearing and the psychology and game theory of indirect speech like bribery.
why: HN commenters cite it for Pinker's analysis of profanity and of why talking about taboo words differs from using them.

quote.text: For more on this topic, I recommend Steven Pinker's 2007 talk at Google.
